description: This file contains ARM assembly code specifically for flushing the data cache (D-cache) on v7 architecture, originally part of the Linux kernel's microcode for ARM devices with specific cache management routines. It is tailored for Broadcom devices with known bootloader issues and includes functions for cache maintenance at different cache levels.

methods.name: v7_flush_dcache_all
methods.description: Function to flush the entire data cache on ARM v7 architecture using inline assembly instructions.
